title: Joojeh Kebab
steps: Prepare the saffron water by grinding the threads of saffron and salt to a fine powder in a mortar.  Dissolve the powder in 1 Tbsp of boiling water and set aside.
Prepare the marinade in a large container by mixing all the ingredients together.
Cut the chicken into 1” cubes.  Each breast (half) should produce approximately 6 cubes.
Add the chicken cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Marinade the meat in the refrigerator for 24 hours (best), 12 hours (good), or a minimum of 2 hours.

Take the meat out of the refrigerator 30-60 minutes before grilling to come up to room temperature.  Assemble onto medium thick skewers and grill over high heat.  Flip the skewers every 1-2 minutes, basting with butter after each flip.  Remove from the grill when the largest cubes reach an internal temperature of 160 degrees F, approximately 8 minutes.  Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
reviewFlags: The source calls for butter to baste without listing a quantity.
